senses.en: to dishonestly take or use money entrusted to one's care

example.en: The manager was accused of misappropriating company funds.
example.zh: 这位经理被指控挪用公司资金。

senses.en: to compensate someone for loss or damage

example.en: The insurer will indemnify the company for the stolen goods.
example.zh: 保险公司将就失窃货物向该公司作出赔偿。

senses.en: to protect someone from future loss or legal liability

example.en: The contract indemnifies the seller against future claims.
example.zh: 该合同保障卖方免受未来的索赔。

senses.en: a serious illness caused by spending too long in strong sun or heat

example.en: He was warned not to work outdoors at noon to avoid sunstroke.
example.zh: 他被提醒不要在正午于户外工作，以免中暑。

senses.en: feeling sad and discouraged

example.en: Don't be downhearted; things will get better soon.
example.zh: 别灰心，情况很快会好转的。

senses.en: a paint made with water-soluble pigments, or a picture painted with it

example.en: She painted a lovely watercolor of the harbor.
example.zh: 她画了一幅可爱的海港水彩画。

senses.en: to paint with watercolors

example.en: He watercolored the landscape in the afternoon.
example.zh: 他下午用水彩画了这幅风景。

senses.en: to take a machine or structure apart piece by piece

example.en: Workers dismantled the old bridge last spring.
example.zh: 工人们去年春天拆除了那座旧桥。

senses.en: to gradually end an organization or system

example.en: The government plans to dismantle the trade barriers.
example.zh: 政府计划逐步废除贸易壁垒。

senses.en: a long seed container that grows on plants such as peas and beans

example.en: She opened the pod and took out the green peas.
example.zh: 她剥开豆荚，取出青豌豆。

senses.en: a small protective case or compartment
senses.zh: 保护性外壳；（飞机等的）吊舱

example.en: The seed is stored in a protective pod.
example.zh: 种子存放在保护荚壳中。

senses.en: to remove something from its pod, or to form pods

example.en: The plants podded early this season.
example.zh: 今年这个季节植物结荚较早。

senses.en: the part of a scene nearest to the viewer

example.en: A row of flowers stands in the foreground of the photo.
example.zh: 一排花位于照片的前景。

senses.en: to give special importance or attention to something

example.en: The report foregrounds the risks of climate change.
example.zh: 这份报告突出了气候变化的风险。

senses.en: relating to a government that controls every part of public and private life

example.en: The country lived under a totalitarian regime for decades.
example.zh: 这个国家在极权主义政权下生活了几十年。

senses.en: a person who supports totalitarian government

example.en: The dictator was a totalitarian who crushed all opposition.
example.zh: 那个独裁者是一个压制一切反对派的极权主义者。

senses.en: behaving in a hostile or threatening way

example.en: An aggressive dog may bark and growl at strangers.
example.zh: 好斗的狗可能会对陌生人吠叫和低吼。

senses.en: acting with determination and energy to achieve goals

example.en: The company has an aggressive growth plan for next year.
example.zh: 该公司有一项明年积极进取的增长计划。

senses.en: tending to spread quickly and harmfully (of diseases or cells)

example.en: Doctors identified a highly aggressive form of cancer.
example.zh: 医生确认了一种恶性程度很高的癌症。

senses.en: a short piece of writing about a subject

example.en: She wrote an essay about climate change for her class.
example.zh: 她为课程写了一篇关于气候变化的短文。

senses.en: to try to do something

example.en: The young actor essayed the role of Hamlet.
example.zh: 这位年轻演员尝试饰演哈姆雷特这个角色。

senses.en: located in, facing, or coming from the east
senses.zh: 东部的；向东的；来自东方的

example.en: The eastern side of the house stays cool in the afternoon.
example.zh: 房子东侧下午比较凉快。

senses.en: relating to the East, especially Asia or eastern Europe
senses.zh: 东方（尤指亚洲或东欧）的

example.en: She is reading about eastern philosophy.
example.zh: 她正在读关于东方哲学的书。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition or contest

example.en: She was the winner of the school spelling contest.
example.zh: 她是学校拼写比赛的获胜者。

senses.en: a person or thing that is very successful

example.en: The new phone is a winner with young buyers.
example.zh: 这款新手机很受年轻买家欢迎。

senses.en: the grounds and buildings of a university, college, or school
senses.zh: 校园；大学或学院的场地和建筑

example.en: Students often study outdoors on campus in spring.
example.zh: 春天学生们常常在校园里户外学习。

senses.en: relating to cause and effect; involving causes

example.en: Researchers found a causal link between smoking and lung cancer.
example.zh: 研究人员发现了吸烟与肺癌之间的因果联系。

senses.en: not required to do something that others must do, such as pay a tax

example.en: Charities are exempt from income tax.
example.zh: 慈善机构免缴所得税。

senses.en: to officially free someone from a duty or requirement

example.en: The new law exempts small businesses from the fee.
example.zh: 新法律豁免小型企业缴纳这项费用。

senses.en: good for your health

example.en: A wholesome breakfast gives you energy for the day.
example.zh: 有益健康的早餐能给你一整天的能量。

senses.en: morally good and innocent

example.en: The film offers wholesome entertainment for the whole family.
example.zh: 这部电影为全家提供健康向上的娱乐。

senses.en: simple, plain, and cozy, like home

example.en: The hotel room had a homely feel with warm lamps and soft chairs.
example.zh: 酒店房间里暖色的台灯和柔软的椅子让人感到温馨如家。

senses.en: (especially of a person, mainly US) not attractive in appearance
senses.zh: （多用于美式英语，形容人）不好看的，相貌平平的

example.en: He was a homely child but grew into a handsome man.
example.zh: 他小时候长得不好看，长大后却成了英俊的男人。

senses.en: the destruction of a ship at sea, or the remains of a wrecked ship

example.en: Divers explored the shipwreck at the bottom of the sea.
example.zh: 潜水员探索了海底的沉船残骸。

senses.en: a complete failure or ruin of plans or hopes
senses.zh: 毁灭；（计划、希望的）彻底失败

example.en: The scandal led to the shipwreck of his political career.
example.zh: 这桩丑闻导致他政治生涯的毁灭。

senses.en: to destroy a ship, or to ruin something completely

example.en: The storm shipwrecked the boat on a rocky island.
example.zh: 风暴使那艘船在多岩石的岛屿上失事。

senses.en: a secret plan by two or more people to do something harmful or illegal

example.en: The police uncovered a conspiracy to rob the bank.
example.zh: 警方破获了一起抢劫银行的阴谋。

senses.en: relating to the process of growth or development

example.en: Children go through important developmental stages in their first few years.
example.zh: 儿童在出生后的头几年会经历重要的发展阶段。

senses.en: happening in or affecting the whole country

example.en: The government launched a nationwide campaign against smoking.
example.zh: 政府发起了一场全国性的禁烟运动。

senses.en: throughout the whole country

example.en: The product will be sold nationwide from next month.
example.zh: 该产品将从下月起在全国范围内销售。

senses.en: the dead body of a human being

example.en: The detective examined the corpse carefully.
example.zh: 侦探仔细检查了尸体。

senses.en: to complete or come to the end of something

example.en: She finished her homework before dinner.
example.zh: 她在晚饭前做完了作业。

senses.en: to use up or consume the whole of something

example.en: We finished all the milk, so I'll buy more tomorrow.
example.zh: 我们把牛奶都喝完了，明天我再买一些。

senses.en: the end or last part of something

example.en: The race had a very close finish.
example.zh: 这场比赛的结尾非常接近。

senses.en: the surface quality or appearance of an object

example.en: The table has a smooth, glossy finish.
example.zh: 这张桌子表面光滑有光泽。

senses.en: of or relating to Japan, its people, culture or language
senses.zh: 日本的；日本人的；日语的

example.en: She is taking a Japanese cooking class this summer.
example.zh: 她今年夏天在上一门日式烹饪课。

senses.en: a person from Japan

example.en: Many Japanese visit this city every year.
example.zh: 每年有许多日本人来这座城市游览。

senses.en: the language spoken in Japan

example.en: He has been studying Japanese for three years.
example.zh: 他学日语已经三年了。

senses.en: the process of deciding in advance what to do and how to do it

example.en: Careful planning made the trip a success.
example.zh: 周密的计划使这次旅行很成功。

senses.en: a sweet fizzy drink flavored with kola extract

example.en: He ordered a burger and a cola.
example.zh: 他点了一个汉堡和一杯可乐。

senses.en: a tropical African tree whose seeds contain caffeine

example.en: Cola trees grow in the rainforests of West Africa.
example.zh: 可乐果树生长在西非的热带雨林中。

senses.en: relating to mammals

example.en: Whales share many mammalian traits.
example.zh: 鲸鱼具有许多哺乳动物的特征。

senses.en: a metal loop hanging from a saddle into which a rider puts the foot

example.en: The rider slipped her foot into the stirrup and climbed onto the horse.
example.zh: 骑手把脚伸进马镫，翻身上了马。

collocations: put your foot in the stirrup

senses.en: doing things one has no right to do; overconfident and disrespectful

example.en: It would be presumptuous of me to speak for the whole team.
example.zh: 我代表整个团队发言就太冒昧了。

collocations: it is presumptuous of someone to do something

senses.en: one of the two rounded parts of the body you sit on

example.en: He pulled a muscle in his left buttock while running.
example.zh: 他跑步时拉伤了左臀的肌肉。

senses.en: a short period of excessive eating, drinking, or other activity

example.en: He went on a shopping binge after getting his bonus.
example.zh: 拿到奖金后他疯狂购物了一番。

senses.en: to eat or do something excessively

example.en: She binged on ice cream after the exam.
example.zh: 考试结束后她大吃冰激凌。

senses.en: the handle of a sword or dagger

example.en: He gripped the sword by its hilt.
example.zh: 他握住了剑柄。

senses.en: the child of your aunt or uncle
senses.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹

example.en: My cousin lives in Shanghai.
example.zh: 我的一位表亲住在上海。

senses.en: a person or thing closely related or similar to another

example.en: The two species are close cousins.
example.zh: 这两个物种是近亲。

senses.en: the feeling or state of being happy

example.en: She found happiness in simple things.
example.zh: 她在简单的事物中找到了快乐。

senses.en: Used as the object when the subject is plural and refers to the same people or things.
senses.zh: 当主语为复数且宾语指同一人或物时使用；他们自己、她们自己或它们自己

example.en: The children dressed themselves.
example.zh: 孩子们自己穿好了衣服。

senses.en: Used after a plural noun or pronoun to emphasize that person or thing.
senses.zh: 用于复数名词或代词后，强调本人或本身

example.en: The managers themselves wrote the report.
example.zh: 经理们自己写了报告。

senses.en: Used to refer back to a singular person whose gender is unknown or not stated.
senses.zh: 用于指代性别未知或未说明的单数人，指其本人

example.en: A good writer should not repeat themselves.
example.zh: 好的作家不应重复自己。

senses.en: a small animal that lives in water and has a thin shell and a long tail, often eaten as food

example.en: We cooked shrimp with garlic and rice.
example.zh: 我们用大蒜和米饭煮了虾。

senses.en: an informal word for a small or unimportant person
senses.zh: （非正式）小个子；无足轻重的人

example.en: He was a tiny shrimp of a boy.
example.zh: 他是个小个子男孩。

senses.en: to catch shrimp

example.en: They went shrimping at dawn.
example.zh: 他们黎明时去捕虾。

senses.en: the act of gaining access to a computer system or online account

example.en: The login took only a few seconds after I entered my password.
example.zh: 我输入密码后，登录只花了几秒钟。

senses.en: the username or account details used to enter a system

example.en: I forgot my login, so I couldn't access the account.
example.zh: 我忘了登录信息，所以无法访问账户。

senses.en: an area of low wet land with grassy vegetation

example.en: The birds nest among the reeds in the marsh.
example.zh: 鸟群在沼泽的芦苇丛中筑巢。

senses.en: to put down or press the foot; to walk or step on something

example.en: Be careful not to tread on the flowers.
example.zh: 小心别踩到花。

senses.en: to step or walk heavily

example.en: Workers trod through the muddy field.
example.zh: 工人们踏过泥泞的田野。

senses.en: the patterned grooved surface of a tire that grips the road

example.en: The worn tread made driving in rain dangerous.
example.zh: 磨损的胎面使雨天驾驶变得危险。

senses.en: the part of a step that the foot rests on; the manner of stepping

example.en: I heard the heavy tread of boots on the stairs.
example.zh: 我听到楼梯上传来沉重的脚步声。

senses.en: the middle part or center of something

example.en: She stood calmly in the midst of the crowd.
example.zh: 她平静地站在人群中间。

collocations: in the midst of the crowd
in the midst of a crisis

senses.en: a substance that flows freely, such as water or oil

example.en: Water is the most common liquid on Earth.
example.zh: 水是地球上最常见的液体。

senses.en: in the form of a liquid; flowing rather than solid or gas

example.en: The medicine is available in liquid form for children.
example.zh: 这种药有供儿童使用的液体剂型。

senses.en: clear, bright, and smooth in appearance, like water

example.en: She has large liquid brown eyes.
example.zh: 她有一双水汪汪的棕色大眼睛。

senses.en: a good or admirable quality

example.en: Patience is one of her greatest merits.
example.zh: 耐心是她最大的优点之一。

senses.en: worth or excellence that deserves reward or recognition

example.en: The award was given purely on merit.
example.zh: 该奖项完全依据业绩颁发。

senses.en: to deserve or be worthy of

example.en: His suggestion merits serious consideration.
example.zh: 他的建议值得认真考虑。

senses.en: to not do or attend something

example.en: I usually skip breakfast on busy mornings.
example.zh: 我在忙碌的早晨通常不吃早餐。

senses.en: to move forward by jumping lightly, or to move quickly over part of something

example.en: The children skipped along the path.
example.zh: 孩子们沿着小路轻快地跳着走。

senses.en: a light bouncing step; a passing over of something

example.en: She crossed the yard with a happy skip.
example.zh: 她开心地蹦跳着穿过院子。

senses.en: to bring your eyebrows together because you are angry, worried, or displeased

example.en: She frowned when she read the confusing message.
example.zh: 她读到那条令人困惑的消息时皱起了眉头。

senses.en: a serious or displeased expression with the eyebrows drawn together

example.en: He gave me a quick frown before answering.
example.zh: 他回答前朝我快速皱了一下眉。

senses.en: to disapprove of something (usually 'frown on/upon')

example.en: Many companies frown on employees checking phones during meetings.
example.zh: 许多公司不赞成员工在开会时看手机。

senses.en: to a very serious or extreme degree

example.en: The region was severely damaged by the storm.
example.zh: 该地区受到风暴的严重破坏。

senses.en: in a strict or harsh manner

example.en: The referee punished the foul severely.
example.zh: 裁判严厉地处罚了那次犯规。

senses.en: in or relating to a foreign country across the sea

example.en: The company has many overseas customers.
example.zh: 这家公司有许多海外客户。

senses.en: to or in a foreign country across the sea

example.en: She studied overseas for two years.
example.zh: 她在国外学习了两年。

senses.en: a person who writes music

example.en: Beethoven was a famous composer of symphonies.
example.zh: 贝多芬是著名的交响曲作曲家。

senses.en: a lock of hair that grows in curves; a curved shape

example.en: Her hair fell in soft curls around her face.
example.zh: 她柔软的卷发垂在脸庞两侧。

senses.en: to twist or bend something into a curved shape; to form curves

example.en: She curled her hair before the party.
example.zh: 她在聚会前把头发卷了卷。

senses.en: to lie or sit with the body bent into a rounded shape

example.en: The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
example.zh: 猫蜷缩在沙发上睡着了。

senses.en: to make someone feel upset, hurt, or insulted

example.en: His rude comments offended many people.
example.zh: 他无礼的评论冒犯了许多人。

senses.en: to break a law or rule

example.en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit offend against traffic laws.
example.zh: 超速驾驶的司机违反了交通法规。

senses.en: based on observation, experiment, or experience rather than theory
senses.zh: 经验的；以实证为依据的

example.en: The theory is supported by empirical evidence from many studies.
example.zh: 该理论有来自多项研究的实证证据支持。

senses.en: a person who formally applies for a job, school, or other position

example.en: Every applicant must submit a resume and cover letter.
example.zh: 每位申请人都必须提交简历和求职信。

senses.en: the act of saying no to a request, offer, or invitation

example.en: Her refusal to answer the question surprised everyone.
example.zh: 她拒绝回答这个问题，让所有人都感到惊讶。

senses.en: the right to buy or decide about something before it is offered to others

example.en: The tenant has first refusal on the property if it is sold.
example.zh: 如果这处房产出售，租户享有优先购买权。

senses.en: to formally ask for something such as money, information, or business

example.en: The charity solicited donations from local businesses.
example.zh: 该慈善机构向当地企业募集捐款。

senses.en: very light fine rain

example.en: A light drizzle fell all morning.
example.zh: 整个上午都下着毛毛雨。

senses.en: to rain lightly

example.en: It was drizzling when we left home.
example.zh: 我们出门时正下着毛毛雨。

senses.en: to pour a thin stream of liquid over food

example.en: Drizzle some olive oil over the salad.
example.zh: 在沙拉上淋一些橄榄油。

senses.en: an area of shallow water separated from the sea by sand, rocks, or coral

example.en: The hotel overlooks a turquoise lagoon.
example.zh: 这家酒店俯瞰着一片碧绿的泻湖。

senses.en: a person or group that watches an organization to make sure it follows the rules

example.en: The consumer watchdog investigates unfair business practices.
example.zh: 消费者监督机构调查不公平的商业行为。

senses.en: a dog kept to guard a house or property

example.en: A watchdog barked loudly in the yard.
example.zh: 一只看门狗在院子里大声吠叫。

senses.en: a small wild flower with white petals and a yellow center

example.en: The field was full of daisies in spring.
example.zh: 春天田野里开满了雏菊。

senses.en: a crisp, smooth, shiny fabric often used for dresses

example.en: The bridesmaid wore a gown made of blue taffeta.
example.zh: 伴娘穿着一条蓝色塔夫绸长裙。

senses.en: a mark (″) used to show that a word above should be repeated

example.en: Use a ditto mark instead of repeating the word in a list.
example.zh: 在列表中用同上符号代替重复的词。

senses.en: to repeat an action or statement

example.en: She ordered coffee, and he dittoed her order.
example.zh: 她点了咖啡，他照着点了同样的。

senses.en: used to say the same thing as before

example.en: "I'm tired." "Ditto."
example.zh: “我累了。”“我也是。”

senses.en: a feeling of doubt or worry about something

example.en: I had misgivings about signing the contract.
example.zh: 我对签署这份合同心存疑虑。

senses.en: a person who is rejected or excluded from a group or society

example.en: He felt like an outcast at his new school.
example.zh: 在新学校里，他觉得自己像个被排斥的人。

senses.en: rejected and excluded by others

example.en: They lived an outcast life far from the village.
example.zh: 他们远离村庄，过着被遗弃的生活。

senses.en: relating to sculpture

example.en: The museum displays sculptural works from the 19th century.
example.zh: 博物馆展出19世纪的雕塑作品。

senses.en: resembling sculpture in form or appearance

example.en: The building has a sculptural quality.
example.zh: 这座建筑有雕塑般的美感。

senses.en: a device that changes something from one form or state into another

example.en: You need a power converter to use this device abroad.
example.zh: 在国外使用这台设备需要一个电源转换器。

senses.en: the quality of being easy to predict

example.en: Customers value the predictability of the service.
example.zh: 顾客看重这项服务的可预测性。

senses.en: to fascinate someone completely

example.en: The magician enthralled the audience with his tricks.
example.zh: 魔术师的表演让观众看得入迷。

senses.en: (US) elastic straps worn over the shoulders to hold up trousers

example.en: He wore suspenders with his gray trousers.
example.zh: 他穿灰裤子时戴着吊裤带。

senses.en: (UK) a strap used to hold up stockings

example.en: She bought a pair of suspenders at the shop.
example.zh: 她在商店买了一条吊袜带。

senses.en: taking a lot of time to do

example.en: Filling out the forms was very time-consuming.
example.zh: 填写这些表格非常耗时。
